title: Normalized finite root-line comparisons for tower coefficients
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, Base b [def-sp-tower-shriek-data], schemes X,Y, and f:X→Y. Suppose l is a unit of Γ(Y,O_Y). For every n, inverse image under the actual constant-ring pullback of the finite Tate line over the n-th coefficient quotient is isomorphic to that line on X [def-sp-tower-class-diagonal, def-cbc-strict-constant-tower-operations]. These finite isomorphisms can be chosen simultaneously so that their finite ordinary adjunct sends each a tensor z to the actual constant direct-image image of a tensor restrictRoot(z) [def-sp-tower-class-pullback]. No tower-transition or system-isomorphism assertion is included.

proof.text: Map the global unit l along f.appTop to Γ(X,O_X), and from each global section ring to each residue field. This supplies the residue-field invertibility instances on X and Y. Base.finite makes every actual coefficient quotient finite. Apply spFiniteTwists_cartesian to each quotient with exponent n, taking the signed degree-one comparison, which is the ordinary finite Tate line itself.

The finite comparison theorem supplies its tensor formula. Under the roots-section equivalence the prescribed roots direct-image map is pullback of a root by the global-sections projection map. This is exactly restrictRoot. Substitute this equality into that formula to obtain the required equation on all charts.

proof_origin.place: classes (2), applying the already proved finite Tate comparisons to the actual tower coefficient quotients

lean.statement:
theorem finiteLineComparisons_exists
    {b : SpTowerShriek.Base l E} {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hY : IsUnit (l : Γ(Y, ⊤))) :
    ∃ δ : ∀ n : ℕ,
      (proEtaleConstantRingPullback (SpTowerShriek.R l E n) f).obj
        (finiteLine l E Y n) ≅ finiteLine l E X n,
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Y.ProEtᵒᵖ)
        (a : (SpTowerShriek.B l E Y n).obj.obj U)
        (z : (Scheme.proEtaleRootsOfUnitySheaf Y (l ^ (n + 1))).obj.obj U),
        (((proEtaleConstantRingAdjunction (SpTowerShriek.R l E n) f).homEquiv _ _)
          (δ n).hom).val.app U
            (Scheme.tateFiniteTensor Y l (FiniteRing l E n) n (finiteScalar l E n)
              U.unop a z) =
          Scheme.tateFiniteTensor X l (FiniteRing l E n) n (finiteScalar l E n)
            (chart f U).unop
            ((Scheme.proEtaleConstantDirectImageMap.{u, u + 2} f CommRingCat.{u + 1}
              (CommRingCat.of (FiniteRing l E n))).hom.app U a)
            (restrictRoot l f n U z)
